generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
OTHER CONDITIONS APPLY ACCORDING TO KW-3 DOCUMENT
Estimations are prepared excluding the 18 percent GST
If there are any clarifications regarding tender should be raised within the scheduled tender query date. Any requests received after that will not be considered
If you fail to submit all the required documents to obtain the work order within 20 days from the date of issuance of the acceptance letter, action will be taken as per the rules

itemList.description:
Providing and fixing factory made Kitchen Cabinet Shutter/Partition 20 mm 
nominal thickness of approved shade, quality and make, made from rigid 
foam sheets (Single extruded) having density 600 kg/m3 and laminated on 
both side by laminate Sheet/PVC foil lamination. The exposed edges shall 
be sealed with PVC edge beading of same shade and colour. The shutter 
shall be fire retardent having necessary screw holding capacity. Shutter 
shall be fixed to frame using approved hinges with necessary stainless steel 
screws, all complete as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. ---- WITH ALL LEAD AND LIFT AND AS PER THE DIRECTION OF ENGINEER IN-CHARGE OF WORK

Providing and supplying  Kitchen cabinet with  19mm thick one side 
Architect recommended decorative Acrylic Glossy or Matt finished 
laminate (1.5mm thick) and other side balancing lamination(preferably 
white) on factory pressed bwp grade marine ply as per IS 710 of 
approved brand . complete as per direction of  engineer in-charge.
(Payment of providing and fixing auto closing hinges shall be paid 
separately) ---- WITH ALL LEAD AND LIFT AND AS PER THE DIRECTION OF ENGINEER IN-CHARGE OF WORK

Providing  and  fixing  glazing  in  aluminium  door,  window,  ventilator 
shutters  and  partitions  etc.  with  EPDM  rubber  /  neoprene  gasket 
etc. complete as per the architectural drawings and the directions of 
engineer-in-charge . (Cost of aluminium snap beading shall be paid in 
basic item):With float glass panes of 5 mm thickness (weight not less 
than 12.50 kg/m²)  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of 
machinery complete as per specifications. ---- WITH ALL LEAD AND LIFT AND AS PER THE DIRECTION OF ENGINEER IN-CHARGE OF WORK

PLY STORAGE 900 mm W X 430 mm D X 1200 mm ---- WITH ALL LEAD AND LIFT AND AS PER THE DIRECTION OF ENGINEER IN-CHARGE OF WORK

Providing and fixing aluminium work for doors, windows, ventilators 
and  partitions  with  extruded  built  up  standard  tubular  sections/

:For shutters of doors, windows & ventilators including providing and fixing hinges/ pivots and making provision for  fixing of fittings wherever
